record.prompt: Please run the September 2026 report (scripts/monthly.sh 2026-09) and tell me the total. Don't change the script itself.
record.final_answer:
The September 2026 total is **5437.50**.

The first run failed because the `out/` directory didn't exist, and the script writes its result there before printing it. I created the directory with `mkdir -p out` and ran the script again. I didn't change the script. `out/` is already gitignored, so the working tree stays clean.

I also added up the five rows in `data/2026-09.csv` myself (1250.00 + 380.50 + 2210.75 + 96.25 + 1500.00) and got the same 5437.50. The file's last row has no newline at the end, but awk still counted it.
